typography.font_family_heading: Space Grotesk, Syne, Instrument Serif, monospace

typography.heading_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
rules: Use mono uppercase labels for all industrial parameter controls, section numbers (e.g., [SEC_01]), and hardware badges.
Never exceed text-6xl for hero titles.
Header text must contrast at least 4.5:1 against beige bone or dark graphite backgrounds.

colors.theme_mode: Light Warm Bone default with Dark Graphite & Previews visual mode switching
rules: No direct flat pure black #000000 for text or backgrounds; use tinted warm charcoal #1C1917 or dark graphite #121110.
CTA primary actions use signature Teenage-Engineering Industrial Orange #FF5A00.
Keep transparent overlays non-zero blur and min 70% opacity background.

visual_enhancers.led_indicator: w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#FF5A00] animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_#FF5A00]
visual_enhancers.corner_screws: Four subtle metallic or engraved screw marks on hero chassis corners for physical authenticity

audio_system.web_audio_clicks: Synthesized audio feedback using Web Audio API (AudioContext) for zero external latency.
audio_system.sound_states: Master Sound Toggle (Off by default as required). When ON, plays mechanical key click, rotary dial tick, rocker switch toggle, or drawer slide sounds on interactions.
audio_system.toggle_component: Header audio toggle styled like a physical toggle switch with green/orange LED state.

testing_and_data_attrs.rules: All buttons, toggles, dialog triggers, tabs, links, and forms must include testable kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the React app uses JavaScript (.jsx / .js) files matching existing frontend setup.
Implement Web Audio API click synthesis in lib/soundEffects.js so buttons make realistic physical clicks when sound is enabled.
Provide a seamless header navigation that includes the Sound Switch, Theme Switcher, and a link to '/previews'.
Build the 4 clickable interactive style previews on '/previews' with immediate preview switching capability.
Include sample rich data for 6 realistic AI/SaaS products with full details (Problem, Solution, Built With, Result Metrics, Live Demo Link).
Ensure high contrast compliance, accessible keyboard focus rings, and responsive grid arrangements.
Place data-testid on every interactive element.
